name: gap_and_go_with_volume_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps open with elevated institutional participation (first-5-minute cumulative volume > 2.5x the session's average 5-minute volume rate), VWAP-benchmarked execution algorithms face a rapidly diverging benchmark — their VWAP is drifting away from their fill price. The first pullback to session VWAP (within 09:20-10:00 IST) is where these VWAP algos aggressively re-engage: they are getting fills AT or BELOW their day's benchmark, making incremental accumulation cost-optimal. On NIFTY at 5-second resolution, the exact VWAP touch bar (low <= session_VWAP for gap-up; high >= session_VWAP for gap-down) followed by a close back in the gap direction signals this institutional re-engagement, creating a 15-30 spot point continuation as the VWAP algo orders absorb residual supply/demand.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Day-level anchor — not a rolling lookback. The gap is fixed at market open and broadcast to all bars in the day. No scaling needed: this is a once-per-day state variable, not a window indicator.

indicators.name: session_vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from 09:15 per day_id
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP — no lookback to scale. Running accumulator resets each day at 09:15. Standard benchmark for institutional algo execution.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW — same 5 calendar minutes (09:15-09:20 = 60 bars at 5s) regardless of bar size. NOT 12x scaled. The denominator uses the morning-session average volume rate (09:20-13:00) to avoid look-ahead bias from using the opening 5 min in its own denominator. A ratio > 2.5 indicates institutional participation, not retail noise.

indicators.name: vwap_touch
indicators.formula: any((low[i-3:i] <= session_vwap[i-3:i]) AND (high[i-3:i] >= session_vwap[i-3:i])) — bar range straddles VWAP
indicators.purpose: 3-bar (15-second) lookback for VWAP touch detection using a straddle check: a bar touches VWAP when its high-low range contains the VWAP level (low <= vwap AND high >= vwap). This is more robust than a low-only or high-only test because it catches both a gap-up bar approaching VWAP from above (low dips to/below VWAP) and a gap-down bar approaching from below (high reaches to/above VWAP) within the same unified condition. Original had vwap_touch as a 1-bar binary; at 5-second resolution a 3-bar window captures the brief VWAP test before the bounce without requiring exact bar precision.

conditions: price_range_3bar straddles session_vwap: any of last 3 bars had (low <= vwap AND high >= vwap) — bar range contains VWAP level, indicating a genuine touch from either direction
close > session_vwap (bounced back above VWAP on current bar)
vix < 22 (high VIX means gaps fade, not continue)
buy_ce.confirmation: 5-second bar closes above session VWAP after touching it, with positive gap context

conditions: price_range_3bar straddles session_vwap: any of last 3 bars had (low <= vwap AND high >= vwap) — bar range contains VWAP level (same unified straddle check as buy_ce)
close < session_vwap (bounced back below VWAP on current bar)
buy_pe.confirmation: 5-second bar closes below session VWAP after touching it, with negative gap context

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points at delta ~0.5. If NIFTY breaks back through session VWAP by 10+ spot points after the touch-and-bounce, the VWAP algo absorption thesis has failed and the gap is fading instead. This stop is deliberately wider than a pure scalp (3 pts) because VWAP itself has 3-5 spot point noise bands — a 5-pt option stop filters VWAP noise while still protecting capital.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points = ~16 NIFTY spot points. NIFTY's post-VWAP-bounce continuation in a gap session extends 15-30 spot points to the first resistance (typically the opening 5-minute high/low). Capturing 50-60% of the expected first leg at 1:1.6 R:R is conservative; the 30-120s hold window aligns with the time it takes institutional VWAP algos to absorb the available supply/demand.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 22 — VIX > 22 signals stress regime where gap-and-go continuation breaks down and gaps fade instead
filters.time_filter: entry only 09:20-10:00 IST — VWAP pullback gap trades are only reliable in the first 45 minutes while the gap thesis is fresh and VWAP algos are still accumulating
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio > 2.5x in opening 5 min — core filter for institutional presence
filters.trend_filter: gap direction defines the directional bias; no separate trend filter needed

edge.edge_decay_risk: Moderate — as more HFT algos detect VWAP-touch-and-bounce setups, the bounce will become faster and shallower; 5s entry already helps vs original 1-min entry, but the edge will compress as index options market becomes more efficient at 5s resolution

adaptation_notes: Original trades individual FnO stocks (gap > 0.5%, 20-day vol history). Six key adaptations: (1) Gap threshold reduced from 0.5% to 0.4% — NIFTY gaps are inherently smaller than individual stocks due to 50-stock diversification; a 0.4% NIFTY gap is as 'significant' as a 0.6-0.8% individual stock gap. (2) vol_ratio baseline changed from 20-day historical to intra-session 09:20-13:00 average — avoids multi-day lookback requirement in a streaming compute function. (3) Hold time compressed from 15-60 min to 30-120s — VWAP touch-and-bounce on NIFTY executes in seconds (algo-driven) not minutes (human-driven); 5s bars let us enter at the exact touch bar. (4) Target changed from HOD/LOD retest (too far at 5s) to first continuation leg (~16 spot pts). (5) Session window narrowed from 09:20-11:30 to 09:20-10:00 — gap-and-go VWAP pullbacks degrade rapidly after 10:00 as the gap context fades and competing signals dominate. (6) ATR stop replaced with fixed option premium stop — ATR is not meaningful for option premium point sizing.
weaknesses: NIFTY gaps > 0.4% occur only ~15-20% of trading days — low trade frequency means high variance in daily P&L
vol_ratio baseline uses morning session average which may itself be elevated on high-vol days, reducing ratio sensitivity
VWAP touch detection at 5s resolution may trigger on bid-ask noise rather than a genuine institutional test
Gap-up with strong continuation may never touch VWAP at all — missed entries on strongest gap days
Gap_pct computation depends on correct day boundary identification via day_id; pre-open bars may distort if included

_source.original_target: high_of_day for longs, low_of_day for shorts
